context: Asuka leads a seminar comparing two arguments.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: seminar; analytical connectives (かつ/つて/いれ/ただし/そのもの) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い主張は、明確かつ誠実です。
lines.en: A good argument is clear and sincere.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 誠実さそのものが、大事なんですね。
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ただし、感情を入れすぎてもいけません。
lines.en: However, you mustn't pour in too much emotion.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 昔は、つてで資料を集めたとか。
lines.en: In the past, they gathered data through connections.
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今は、つてに頼らず手に入れられます。
lines.en: Now you can obtain it without connections.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 論理そのものを、磨くべきですね。
lines.en: We should polish the logic itself.
lines.style: understanding young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 明確かつ丁寧に、力を入れましょう。
lines.en: Let's put effort into being clear and polite.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ただし、心も忘れずに、ですね。
lines.en: However, without forgetting the heart, right.
lines.style: warm young student voice, soft warm realization throughout
